agendas.name: Skalender
agendas.hint:
Ska/Reggae/Dub/Punk-Agenda für die Schweiz, Community-Einträge. Beste Einzelquelle, aber gemischt mit Punk/Rock. On the homepage, events are inside
    : month headers
  • (German month abbreviations Okt, Nov, Dez, Jan, Feb, Mrz, Mai, plus year) followed by
  • items, each with , DD and

    City
    Acts

    . Acts are joined with ' & ' (sometimes 'feat.' or a tour name in guillemets); city names are sometimes lowercase ('zürich') and the same show is occasionally listed twice (e.g. Dub Pistols 21 Oct, Open Season 19 Dec). Genres are the cat-item classes: 4=Ska, 5=Punk, 6=Reggae, 7=Rock, 8=Metal, 9=Latin, 23=Dub, 25=Folk (3=All, ignore); on detail pages the same appear as event-style-ska/reggae/dub classes. Detail pages have Mittwoch 21. Oktober 2026, time range '19:00 - 22:30', price 43.60 CHF followed by the ticket link (    Tickets kaufen, typically petzi.ch, ticketmaster.ch, eventfrog), an 'Event Webseite' link to the venue/organizer page, venue name linking to /venues// and street address + city (Google Maps link), and artist links to /artists// (artist pages list Herkunft and Stile). Text is German.

agendas.name: Petzi
agendas.hint:
Ticketing der Schweizer Clubs. Keine Genre-Filter, nur Volltextsuche: auch ?q=ska, ?q=dub, ?q=dancehall, ?q=sound%20system abfragen; Treffer sind nach Relevanz sortiert und verrauscht, jede Show auf der Detailseite prüfen. Event tiles are with DD.MM.YYYY,

Title

and
Venue
; the attribute holds the untruncated title and venue (tile titles are cut with "..."). Titles are the organiser's free text: acts separated by "+", "//", "&", "|", "w/", "Support:", with country codes in parentheses or brackets, e.g. "RAKOON [FR] + TUZI SOUND SYSTEM [FR]". The detail page has

title, a

with the long English date ("Friday 23 October 2026"),

Venue – City

, "Doors open at: HH:MM" / "Event starts at: HH:MM", a French/German/English description in

, an "Organized by" link (/en/organiser/{n}/), and genre tags in

as Reggae (tags like Concert, Club, Reggae, Hip-Hop; many organisers leave it empty, so also scan the description for reggae/ska/dub/dancehall/sound system). Ticket link is "/en/events/{id}-{slug}/tickets/" with "Price starting at CHF xx.xx" when Petzi sells tickets; otherwise only a "See the official website" link; the Google-calendar link and .ics file contain the full venue street address and start/end times.
